interpolation: Bounded trilinear; half-cell block edges clamped to center hull. Nearest-cell comparison separately recorded.
normalization: raw code units; no hydro normalization
caveats: Matched-phase means interpolate bracketed saved times, not full-visit time averages. Quadrature and nearest-cell sensitivities are not rigorous spatial error bounds. Shell cell assignment is coarse. No continuous mass balance through frozen intervals. Near-drain pressure is timestep sensitive.
